journey: Review and edit a conflicting event approval on mobile without executing it
goal: Identify the conflicting event and exact overlap, understand the pending operation, and reach a safe edit/reject/leave-pending choice.
baseline: Iteration 2 supplied event title, occupied interval, and exact backend-computed overlap. Remaining risks were stale/incomplete review during approve/edit, editor payload shape, asynchronous edit focus, and keyboard-aware navigation restoration.
changes: Refresh current conflict and review completeness before approval or edit; leave proposals pending when review is incomplete or a fresh conflict exists.

Treat event-version changes after proposal creation as a refreshed review: update the pending proposal to the current expected version, show a notice, and require a new explicit decision with a new idempotency key.
Resolve null start/end values in the legacy update_event preview to the current event times, matching the tool's partial-update semantics.
Keep an incomplete/conflicting edit open with a clear pending-state message; do not apply the submitted edit until review is complete.
Remove presentation-only fields from event mutation replay and block invalid start/end intervals in the editor.
For a mutation with time: null, show the current event times in the editor without submitting them unless the user changes a time; preserve the other endpoint when only one endpoint changes.
Preserve an existing reminder target while the asynchronous target list loads or omits it; retry editor focus when the target control becomes ready.
Track actual visual viewport coverage so mobile navigation returns after the soft keyboard closes, even if the input retains focus.

evidence.backend: 638 passed, 3 skipped in full suite; includes refreshed-conflict, stale-version/idempotency, incomplete-review, and resumed strict-tool cases.
evidence.frontend: 26 files / 143 unit tests passed; ESLint and production build passed.
evidence.playwright: Full smoke file passed 20/20 after final changes; includes 320px conflict inspection, keyboard edit/focus/cancel, scrolling, and viewport-aware navigation.
evidence.blind_pair: Independent screenshot judge preferred X, the exact-overlap candidate, with confidence 0.78.
evidence.holdout: Static simulator identified the event and exact overlap, satisfaction 4/5, and reported scrolling to reach the controls.
evidence.critics: Initial and follow-up P2 findings were fixed. The final read-only adversarial recheck found no remaining reproducible scoped P1/P2. Accessibility review found no new scoped P1/P2; keyboard cancel and real assistive-technology/device behavior remain unverified.

remaining_limits: The 320px holdout screenshot requires scrolling to reach action controls.
Evaluations use fixture data and intercepted API requests; no browser-to-live-AgentRun approval, apply, or Today/Calendar propagation was run.
No human participant study, real mobile device, VoiceOver/TalkBack, or screen-reader walkthrough was performed.
